Guy Fieri turns up the pressure at Flavortown Market with a cold storage rescue challenge. With team captains' partners locked inside the sub-zero storage unit, the competing chefs must race through the aisles, collect ingredients that reveal a puzzle code and cook an impressive entree before time runs out. Can they complete the rescue and deliver a winning dish under pressure?
Watch Guy's Grocery Games Season 37 Episode 5 only on discovery+ India.
